newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast prods flatten late, APIs dismissed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast prods flatten late, APIs dismissed.

text.p: U.S. West Coast products prices flattend late, with dealing sapped by an industry conference and traders dismissing weekly inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute (API).
API reported supplies of crude oil in PADD 5 West Coast fell 3.1 million barrels to 68.6 million last week, but West Coast brokers and traders watched distillate stocks out east with greater concern.
"If (eastern prices) go way up, we'll be exporting," said a West Coast refined products broker, referring to an unseasonal draw in U.S. stocks.
